text: The Abu Dhabi Sports Council describes itself as the organiser of the UAE Tour and the UAE Tour Women. Its January 2026 press release on the 2026 editions confirmed 18 UCI WorldTeams plus 3 UCI ProTeams for the men's race, and 14 Women's WorldTeams, 3 Women's ProTeams and 3 Women's Continental Teams for the women's race.

source.name: Abu Dhabi Sports Council press release - The teams of the 2026 edition of the UAE Tour and UAE Tour Women are announced
source.quote: Abu Dhabi Sports Council, organisers of the UAE Tour and the UAE Tour Women, are pleased to confirm the full list of teams participating in the 2026 edition
